notes:
**CHR-1097 — use-case sort menu, data example placeholder, form pickers** (follow-up to CHR-1062, epic CHR-1060). The full use-case spec stays in the `chr-1062` tag note; this tag marks what changed.

- **Sort:** Group A–Z · Title · Status, no "Recently changed" (Christian, 2026-11-16). Notes of `usecases-list`; open menu drawn in the new overlay `usecases-list-sort-menu`. Matches the build.
- **Placeholders:** input/output example `status: ready` (was `screen: usecases-detail, node: btn-mapping`, which read like a step target); step data change before `status: draft`, after `status: ready` (was `scope: screen` → `node: btn-mapping, scope: element`). Other placeholders checked and kept. Code change needed: the two placeholder strings in the use-case form.
- **Form controls: native confirmed, no redesign.** Closed lists = native `<select>` with plain text options (`uc-select`); free text with suggestions = `<input list>` + `<datalist>` (`chrome-field`). The edit dialog drawing now matches the build: step actor shows the name only (no avatar), group, step screen and step element are text fields without chevron, the element field holds the id only. Persona role is a text field too. A value that does not resolve uses the new `chrome-field` variant `warning`; `uc-select` lost its unused `mono` and `warning` variants. No code change for this part.

Screens: `usecases-list`, `usecases-list-sort-menu`, `usecases-edit-dialog`, `usecases-edit-dialog-persona`. Components: `chrome-field` (+ `warning`), `uc-select` (− `mono`, − `warning`).
